statement: Historical hid-sony expected USB feature 0x81 of length 7, with MAC beginning at offset 1, whereas current hid-playstation requests pairing 0x12; no independent source here verifies actual device-side coexistence or transport/revision policy.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-sony.c 505–508, 2615–2638; hid-playstation.c 2148–2175. Manufacturer MAC values explicitly excluded from publication.
